name: Innovation New Material Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Innovation New Material Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the production, processing, and sale of non-ferrous aluminum in China. It offers lightweight automotive profiles and structural components, such as motor housing, threshold beam, battery pack base plate, and battery pack frame, as well as KOMO thermal management system, bracket steering arm connector, transmission system, security system, and new energy battery pack system components.
